description: `aspire update` now updates repository-local Aspire CLI tool manifest pins (`.config/dotnet-tools.json`, `dotnet-tools.json`, and `package.json`) alongside AppHost integration updates, instead of treating CLI version pinning as a `--self`-only operation. Restoring/installing the updated CLI and refreshing lockfiles remains the package manager's responsibility; `aspire update --self` is unchanged.
name: aspire update now updates repository CLI manifest pins
